top_concerns: Main rate of Thm 3 appears to follow from known strongly adaptive regret via Abel summation; the paper never analyses this reduction
Proof of Lemma 1, presented as new and complete, has an invalid final step and a hypothesis mismatch (U(n) >= 20 vs 22)
'Cost of adaptivity' and 'novel analysis' are asserted without a lower bound or a list of what changed relative to Kapralov-Panigrahy and Zhang et al. 2022a
Horizon T must be known and the stated lambda range restriction is vacuous; the scope of 'unknown discount factor' is narrower than the abstract suggests
No sanity experiment, no limitations discussion; imported lemmas make the analysis not self-contained
notes: Phase 1.5 literature check could not run (arXiv queries timed out, no network), so recommended references are marked [verify] and the decisive 'strongly adaptive regret implies discounted regret' point rests on a recalled rate.
